artifact.description: Consumer declines to clear the obstruction. The choice itself produces a (near-empty) Consequence record with equal standing to Action, and the location continues to evolve afterward via an independent WorldProcess rather than freezing.
artifact.notes: Demonstrates R15 (NonAction has a linked Consequence, not silence) and that the non-intervened branch is NOT bit-for-bit identical to its Visit-01-exit state (NON-ACTION-CONTINUES-TO-CHANGE.md) — the empty worldStateDelta on the non-action record itself is deliberate (nothing changed BECAUSE of the choice), while the subsequent WORLD_PROCESS_CAUSED consequence shows the location still evolves.
